# Security Policy

## Supported Versions

Only the latest released version on [Packagist](https://packagist.org/packages/pachristos/filament-export-cleanup) receives security updates. Please upgrade to the latest release when a fix is published.

## Reporting a Vulnerability

**Do not open a public GitHub issue or discussion for security vulnerabilities.**

Please report privately using one of these methods:

1. **Preferred:** [GitHub private vulnerability reporting](https://github.com/Christos-Papoulas/filament-export-cleanup/security/advisories/new)
2. **Email:** [pachristos@gmail.com](mailto:pachristos@gmail.com)

### What to include

- Description of the vulnerability
- Steps to reproduce
- Potential impact
- Suggested fix (optional)

### Response

- Acknowledgment within a few days
- Initial assessment shortly after acknowledgment
- We follow coordinated disclosure and will work with you to address the issue before any public release
